title: Transport Facilities
content: SRMIST operates a fleet of over 150 air-conditioned and non-air-conditioned buses connecting various parts of Chennai, including suburbs, to the Kattankulathur, Ramapuram, and Vadapalani campuses. The transport service is optional and available on an annual payment basis. Buses run on pre-scheduled routes starting early in the morning to ensure students and staff reach the campus before 8:30 AM. Each bus is equipped with GPS trackers for real-time monitoring and speed governors to ensure student safety. Detailed route charts, bus stop details, timing schedules, and driver contact numbers are updated on the transport portal at the beginning of the academic year. Students must carry their valid transport ID card at all times while boarding.
